# opnsense_plugin (Resource)

Installs and manages an OPNsense plugin through the native firmware API. The package must be available from a configured OPNsense package repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_plugin" "bind" {
  name                 = "os-bind"
  locked               = false
  uninstall_on_destroy = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Plugin package name, for example `os-bind` or `os-caddy`.

### Optional

- `locked` (Boolean) Lock the installed package against firmware upgrades. Defaults to `false`.
- `uninstall_on_destroy` (Boolean) Uninstall the plugin when the Terraform resource is destroyed. Defaults to `false`; without this explicit opt-in, destroy removes only the Terraform state entry.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Plugin package name.
- `installed` (Boolean) Whether the plugin is installed.
- `provided` (Boolean) Whether the plugin is available from a configured package repository.
- `repository` (String) Repository that supplied the plugin.
- `version` (String) Installed plugin version.
